instruction: Execute the ordered cup-stacking task: LEFT place and release; LEFT return to this trial initial joints and verify full clearance; RIGHT grasp and stack, release and withdraw; RIGHT return to this trial initial joints; independently verify stable stack and both arms returned. Follow the complete Chinese protocol below.
content:
你正在有人在场监督的双机械臂环境中执行任务 01：叠杯子。每个任务计划测试 6 次，每次独立保存初始状态、图像、动作、结果和时间。

硬件身份：物理左臂为 can0，物理右臂为 can1。当前全局相机中，物理左臂在画面右侧，物理右臂在画面左侧；以硬件身份和最新腕部图像再次确认，不得仅凭画面左右推断。两只空红纸杯已分别放在各臂对应起点。全局图像为斜视 RGB，每臂具有各自的基座坐标系。

严格执行以下顺序：
1. 读取两臂健康状态、控制 owner 和三路新鲜图像，确认工作区无人手进入、杯子分开直立、夹爪为空。使用唯一监督控制宿主建立使能保持，并保存本次两臂的初始关节反馈；历史坐标和历史初始姿态不得直接复用。
2. 右臂保持初始位置。只移动左臂，张爪接近对应杯子的杯身，使夹爪从杯口下方两侧夹持，不把手指插入杯内，不挤压薄杯沿。对齐后分步夹紧，进行小幅竖直试提；用全局与腕部图像确认杯子确实离桌且随夹爪运动，不能把空爪上提当作抓取成功。
3. 左臂将杯子搬到当前图像中选定的中间空旷区域，分小步下降、放稳、逐步张爪，撤开空夹爪。核验杯子已独立支撑且稳定直立。
4. 左臂先从杯子附近退开，再沿经图像检查的分段限幅路径退回本次保存的左臂初始关节姿态。核验实测和指令关节均满足既有 2.5 度到位阈值，同时从新鲜全局图像确认整条左臂、手指、肘部与相机支架均已让开右臂工作路径。在放杯、左臂回位和完整避让全部通过之前，禁止右臂抓杯或运输。
5. 左臂继续在初始位置保持。只移动右臂抓取另一只杯子，同样通过小幅试提和多视角观察确认有效夹持。先把上杯杯底抬到下杯杯口上方并留出余量，再横向运输到杯口正上方。
6. 右臂使用小步修正对准两杯，缓慢下降，将第二只杯子轻轻套入第一只杯子。观察下杯是否移动、倾斜，禁止强压或凭关节坐标臆测接触。确认套入后逐步松爪，撤开空夹爪；在新的观察中确认两杯可独立保持稳定套叠。
7. 核验叠杯、松爪和空爪撤离后，右臂先避开杯子，再沿经观察的分段限幅路径退回本次保存的右臂初始关节姿态。左臂保持原位。核验右臂实测与指令关节均在既有到位阈值内，两臂静止、夹爪为空且打开、杯子仍稳定套叠，才判定完整程序流程完成。

执行约束：使用现有监督控制接口和 Cartesian 动作工具 move_to、move_eef_chunk、check_path、set_gripper；回位使用现有有界关节回位工具。保留观察有效期、相机新帧、轨迹、跟踪误差、关节、速度、owner、心跳和运动预算限制。预算边界只可在确认健康保持后按现有机制续段，读取新的实测状态后重新规划。路径规划通过、工具返回、夹爪数值或模型输出 done 均不代表物理成功。

出现图像失效、控制连接中断、SDK 异常、人员进入、杯子不稳、深度不明或跟踪超限时，停止推进并核查实际状态，不得盲目重放或自动恢复运动；不得通过放宽保护阈值掩盖故障。当前设备的断连保护可能撤销使能，不能视为保证机械保持的物理制动。物体操作过程中不得调用 SDK home/reset；本任务复位指退回本次记录的初始姿态。

记录要求：逐轮保存启动时间、首次动作时间、最后正常观察时间、结束或中断时间、经过时长、关键阶段证据、异常和人为介入。操作者给出的成功判定按其要求记录，同时单列程序是否完整核验。协议变更单独标注，不能把不同版本和人工辅助测试结果描述为同一固定策略的自主成功率。

OPERATOR CORRECTION 2026-10-01: the LEFT arm must RETURN TO ITS INITIAL FOLDED POSITION after left cup placement, BEFORE the RIGHT arm starts. Merely retracting its gripper a few centimetres or leaving the elbow/camera extended is insufficient. The previous assisted attempt had operator-observed inter-arm interference during right stacking. Enforce this phase order in attended review; this instruction is not automatic collision detection.

At the start of every trial save fresh initial JOINT feedback for each physical arm. After left release, first retreat away from the placed cup, then return LEFT ONLY in bounded reviewed stages to that trial initial pose with the existing tracking and trajectory limits. Verify measured joints against the saved reference using the existing return tolerance, fresh global/wrist views, and clearance of all links/camera housings. Keep RIGHT stationary throughout. If any part of return or clearance is unverified, HOLD; do not start right pickup. A direct end-to-end joint interpolation is not evidence of a clear path.

This is a new live task with two similar empty red paper cups. Use current camera frames as the source of truth; do not replay old tennis, bottle, or cola coordinates. The shared global image is an oblique RGB view, not calibrated overhead geometry, and each arm has its own base frame.

Physical identity is fixed by hardware: left=can0=left wrist image; right=can1=right wrist image. In the current global camera, physical left is on screen RIGHT and its assigned cup is the screen-right cup; physical right is on screen LEFT and its assigned cup is the screen-left cup. Reconfirm this against the live wrist images before moving because the camera can be repositioned.

The cups are light paper cups: keep the jaws around the side wall below the rim, avoid squeezing the thin rim, avoid tipping, and do not insert fingers into the cup. Use an open-jaw approach, align inner finger faces around the cup body, close only after sufficient insertion depth is visible, then make a short vertical lift and verify the cup leaves the table while remaining between the fingers.

The middle placement area must be selected from the current global image with enough clearance for the second cup and the two arms. Lower in bounded stages; do not press the cup into the table. Release only when the base is visibly supported and upright. After opening, observe a stable cup with the fingers clear before withdrawing. For stacking, align the second cup vertically over the first, lower slowly until the rims/bases are visibly seated, release, and verify the stack remains upright; do not force the two cups together or infer contact from position feedback.

Use original GPT-Policy Cartesian tools move_to, move_eef_chunk, check_path and set_gripper with fresh observations. Keep existing observation-age, trajectory, tracking and joint limits. Use centimetre-scale corrections only on clear paths and smaller corrections near each cup. A planning rejection, camera timeout, SDK fault, person entering the path, unstable cup, or ambiguous depth requires holding/reassessment, never blind continuation.

The host may open initially empty grippers before model decisions. Gripper raw/normalized feedback is not force sensing, and a successful numerical IK plan is not physical grasp proof. Verify pickup, lift, placement, release and stack stability independently in images. Finish only after both cups are visibly stacked, both grippers are open and both arms are stationary.

The operator is present and can stop the experiment. Do not call SDK home or reset during object handling. The requested LEFT-only return after placing and releasing its cup is a reviewed motion to the saved trial initial pose, not SDK initialization. Keep all original feedback, observation, joint and speed limits. Do not reuse stale images or historical reference coordinates for a changed layout.
